battle.name: 安哥拉獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安哥拉（葡萄牙殖民時期）
battle.brief: 安哥拉獨立戰爭於1961年2月正式爆發，葡萄牙殖民軍與安哥拉民族解放組織在城鄉及叢林展開激烈衝突。雙方均大量配備蘇聯製造的AK-47自動步槍，該武器以其堅固可靠著稱，在游擊戰中發揮關鍵作用。

kit.name: AK-47自動步槍
kit.history: AK-47是蘇聯於1947年研製的5.45×39mm口徑自動步槍，以可靠性聞名，成為華約及多國游擊隊的主要步兵武器。

countries: 安哥拉獨立戰爭通常以1961年2月4日安哥拉人民解放運動在羅安達同步襲擊皮吉吉蒂監獄、警察機關、通訊設施與廣播設施為起點，以1974年4月25日葡萄牙軍方推翻獨裁政府、駐安哥拉葡軍隨後停止大規模攻勢為軍事終點；1975年11月11日安哥拉正式獨立則是政治終點。參與者並非單一葡萄牙军队與單一叛軍，而是葡萄牙與安哥拉人民解放運動、前線國家解放陣線及安哥拉全國解放聯盟之間的長期戰爭。北方與剛果共和國及剛果自由邦相通，後者於1966年成為剛果民主共和國；1964年以前北面的北羅德西亞隨後成為尚比亞。MPLA早期依靠剛果兩岸的基地，後來利用坦尚尼亞和尚比亞的邊境通道。FNLA獲得美國秘密局及剛果方面的情報、武器與後勤支援，UNITA亦在後期得到美國及南非協助；MPLA則獲得蘇聯武器、中國軍事顧問與訓練援助。南非情報單位還曾向葡軍提供反游擊情報。這些援助構成冷戰介入，但作戰命令、地面戰術和實際控制仍主要由當地三方與葡軍決定。
countriesEn: The Angolan War of Independence is conventionally traced from the coordinated MPLA attacks on Pidjiguiti prison, police installations, communications facilities, and broadcasting facilities in Luanda on 4 February 1961. Its military endpoint is generally placed on 25 April 1974, when the Portuguese military overturned the dictatorship and the Portuguese forces in Angola subsequently stopped major offensives; independence on 11 November 1975 was its political endpoint. The participants were not simply the Portuguese army on one side and a single rebel movement on the other. They were Portugal, the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola, the Frente Nacional de Libertação de Angola, and the União Nacional Totalista Independente de Angola. To the north, the conflict crossed the borders of the Republic of Congo and Congo-Léopoldville, which became the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1966. Northern Rhodesia, now Zambia, lay farther east. The MPLA initially depended on bases on both sides of the Congo and later used border corridors through Tanzania and Zambia. The FNLA received intelligence, weapons, and logistical assistance from the United States intelligence community and from Congo-based channels. UNITA also received later American and South African assistance, while the MPLA received Soviet weapons and Chinese military advisers and training. South African intelligence personnel also supplied information to Portuguese counter-insurgency forces. These forms of aid made the conflict an extension of the Cold War, although operational decisions, ground tactics, and actual territorial control remained principally the work of the three Angolan organizations and the Portuguese forces.
people: 決定初期戰爭方向的是MPLA於1956年在羅安達建立的地下組織，而不是1961年才臨時出現的隊伍。奧古斯蒂紐內托擔任政治領導，路西奧拉拉則長期掌握軍事指揮，強調小型單位、分散指揮、彈藥分散攜帶與定期返回邊境基地整補。何塞愛杜多斯桑托斯在1969年加入後進入核心指揮層，至1970年代已負責軍事行政與作戰協調；1972年拉拉的整頓以及丹尼爾奇佩達脫離，使MPLA進一步收緊指揮，但也加深其政治孤立。另一條組織路線由霍爾登羅伯托領導，他於1962年在卡薩布蘭卡組成FNLA，並把早期安哥拉民族主義武裝與剛果政治網絡結合。1966年7月，曾在原UPA中活動的若納斯薩文比在盧薩卡成立UNITA，以跨境機動和南部高原攻略建立自己的兵力。葡萄牙方面，早期安哥拉遠征軍團由奧托韋爾吉利奧迪亚斯克雷德爾指揮；1966年起，阿爾普伊姆卡爾旺接管安哥拉軍事指揮，後續職位則由葡萄牙常備軍將領輪替。葡方將本國步兵、工程、通信、炮兵及後勤單位陸續輪調安哥拉，而MPLA、FNLA和UNITA各自維持不同 commanders 與補給系統，使安哥拉並未形成單一民族主義陣線。
peopleEn: The direction of the opening phase was shaped by the underground MPLA organization established in Luanda in 1956, not by a force that suddenly appeared in 1961. Agostinho Neto served as the political leader, while Lúcio Lara exercised prolonged authority over military operations and emphasized small units, decentralized command, ammunition carried in dispersed loads, and periodic returns to border bases for replenishment. José Eduardo dos Santos joined in 1969 and moved into the central command structure, becoming responsible by the 1970s for military administration and operational coordination. Lara's reorganization in 1972 and Daniel Chipenda's departure tightened MPLA command, but they also deepened the movement's political isolation. A separate organizational line was led by Holden Roberto, who formed the FNLA in Casablanca in 1962 and joined early Angolan nationalist fighters to a Congolese political network. In July 1966, Jonas Savimbi, who had previously worked within the former UPA, founded UNITA in Lusaka and built strength through cross-border mobility and operations across the southern plateau. On the Portuguese side, the early Angolan expeditionary corps was commanded by Otto Vergílio Dias Kröder. Alpoim de Calvão took over military command in Angola in 1966, after which the post passed among career officers from the Portuguese mainland army. Portugal rotated infantry, engineers, signals, artillery, and logistics units into Angola, while the MPLA, FNLA, and UNITA each retained separate commanders and supply systems. Angola therefore never developed a single unified nationalist front.
kits: 1961年以前已經列裝而確實符合安哥拉戰場補給條件的步槍，包括1953年採用的FN FAL、1949年採用的AK-47、1945年採用的SKS、1944年採用的Sterling衝鋒槍及1951年採用的PM Makarov手槍。FAL使用7.62×51北約弹药與20發彈匣，AK-47使用7.62×39與30發彈匣，SKS使用同一口徑的10發彈匣；Sterling使用9×19帕拉貝倫姆與20或33發彈匣，Makarov則使用9×18。FNLA和UNITA曾取得FAL，MPLA常見的是蘇聯式7.62×39武器，另有少量1949年列裝的RPG-2反裝甲武器，其40毫米彈藥主要用於攻擊固定火力點。葡萄牙陸軍以FAL作為主要制式步槍，車輛包括1948年的Land Rover Series I、1953年的Bedford CA與1952年的Panhard AML，分別執行偵察、運輸和武裝護送。炮兵包括M2 81毫米迫擊炮及M2A1 105毫米榴彈炮，常見炮彈為81毫米高爆與煙幕彈，以及105毫米高爆彈。航空方面，葡萄牙使用過DHC-3 Otter、C-47、T-6G Texan及PBY Catalina執行運輸、聯絡和武裝巡邏，並以1957年列裝的Alouette II執行偵察、人員輸送與後勤聯絡。葡軍可經羅安達、本格拉與洛比托港口補充7.62×51弹药和炮彈；MPLA的7.62×39弹药則多從剛果分批送入，再由游擊隊以背架、車輛和邊境小庫分散攜帶。這些武器至1961年均已存在，但三方的口徑、制式與補給來源並不一致。
kitsEn: The service weapons available by 1961 that fit the logistics of the Angolan battlefield included the FN FAL, adopted in 1953; the AK-47, adopted in 1949; the SKS, adopted in 1945; the Sterling submachine gun, adopted in 1944; and the PM Makarov pistol, adopted in 1951. The FAL fired 7.62×51 NATO ammunition from twenty-round magazines, while the AK-47 used 7.62×39 ammunition in thirty-round magazines and the SKS used the same caliber in ten-round magazines. The Sterling accepted 9×19 Parabellum ammunition in twenty- or thirty-three-round magazines, while the Makarov used 9×18 ammunition. The FNLA and UNITA obtained FAL rifles, while 7.62×39 weapons of Soviet pattern were more common in the MPLA arsenal. The MPLA also held small quantities of the RPG-2 anti-tank weapon, adopted in 1949; its forty-millimeter warhead was principally useful against fixed firing positions. The Portuguese army used the FAL as its principal service rifle. Its vehicles included the Land Rover Series I of 1948, the Bedford CA of 1953, and the Panhard AML of 1952, used respectively for reconnaissance, transport, and armed escort. Artillery included the M2 81 mm mortar and M2A1 105 mm howitzer, with 81 mm high-explosive and smoke rounds and 105 mm high-explosive projectiles. Portuguese aviation employed the DHC-3 Otter, C-47, T-6G Texan, and PBY Catalina for transport, liaison, and armed patrols, while the Alouette II, adopted in 1957, performed reconnaissance, personnel movement, and logistics. Portugal could replenish 7.62×51 ammunition and artillery projectiles through Luanda, Benguela, and Lobito. Much of the MPLA's 7.62×39 ammunition entered through Congo in separate shipments and was then carried inward by guerrilla teams using packs, vehicles, and small border caches. All of these weapons were already in service by 1961, but calibers, service standards, and supply sources differed among the three Angolan organizations.
tactics: 1961年羅安達的行動採取短時間同步襲擊：突擊小組分別接近監獄、警察崗位與通訊設施，破壞或奪取器材後即撤離，不在市區建立持久陣地。葡萄牙安全部隊隨後以清查、逮捕、封鎖道路和搜索情報網絡拆解城市游擊網，並把武裝人員逐步推向北部、東部及邊境地區。MPLA轉入鄉村後，主要以小隊伏擊側翼、打斷道路護援、短暫襲擊守軍後迅速轉移；小組之間依靠預先約定的會合點與分散彈藥維持行動。FNLA較依賴剛果境內較完整的營區和補給，UNITA則利用尚比亞方向的邊境入口，讓隊伍以機關槍、迫擊炮及四輪或六輪車進行長距離轉向。MPLA在1964年及1970年代轉向營、旅級攻勢，設法攻擊兵站、道路、通信和地方守軍，但後勤仍依賴邊境與分散庫存。葡萄牙則以師級部隊守住交通線，在道路交叉點、橋梁、機場及城鎮外圍建立工事；每次搜索行動由步兵、炮兵、機車、軍車與空中偵察協同，先以炮兵和空襲壓制，再由地面分隊搜索，若情報不足便撤回固定據點。1967至1968年間形成的戰術指揮體系把若干分散連隊納入統一調度，並保留中央預備隊。直升機改變了小隊的機動速度，但未能消除對道路、燃料、彈藥及情報來源的依賴。到1973至1974年，MPLA與UNITA都能實施營級攻擊，葡萄牙也以固定基地和機械化護送應對，三方的戰術差異正逐漸縮小。
tacticsEn: The Luanda operations of 1961 were short coordinated raids. Assault groups approached the prison, police posts, and communications facilities separately, struck to destroy or seize equipment, and withdrew without trying to hold an urban district. Portuguese security forces then dismantled the urban guerrilla network through searches, arrests, road closures, and intelligence work, gradually pushing armed personnel toward the north, east, and frontier regions. Once the MPLA moved into the countryside, its principal methods were small-team ambushes against flanks, attacks on road escorts, brief strikes against garrisons, and rapid withdrawal. Units connected through prearranged rendezvous points and dispersed ammunition stocks. The FNLA depended more heavily on established camps and logistics inside Congo, while UNITA used entry corridors from Zambia and employed machine guns, mortars, and four- or six-wheeled vehicles for long changes of direction. In 1964 and again during the 1970s, the MPLA shifted toward battalion- and brigade-sized offensives directed at depots, roads, communications, and local garrisons, although logistics still depended on border bases and dispersed caches. Portugal used divisional formations to secure transport corridors and established fortified positions at road junctions, bridges, airfields, and the outskirts of towns. A search operation combined infantry, artillery, motorcycles, trucks, and aerial reconnaissance. Artillery and aircraft suppressed suspected positions before ground teams advanced; inadequate intelligence caused the Portuguese to return to fixed posts. The tactical command structure formed between 1967 and 1968 brought dispersed companies under coordinated control and retained a central reserve. Helicopters accelerated the movement of small teams but did not remove dependence on roads, fuel, ammunition, and intelligence sources. By 1973 and 1974, both the MPLA and UNITA could conduct battalion-level attacks, while Portugal relied on fortified bases and motorized escorts in response. Differences in tactics were therefore narrowing.
data: 戰前背景始於1956年12月，當時幾個安哥拉民族主義組織在羅安達合併為MPLA，葡萄牙方面則以秘密警察、軍隊與殖民政權控制政治活動。1961年2月4日，MPLA在羅安達進攻皮吉吉蒂監獄、警察機關、通訊與廣播設施；葡軍迅速封鎖市區，攻擊者未能佔領大片地區，城市網絡在1961至1963年間遭到清剿。此後葡萄牙加強第1步兵師與葡萄牙遠征軍團，把步兵、工程、通信、炮兵及後勤單位配置在羅安達，並保護羅安達至恩達拉通多、馬蘭熱的道路、洛比托鐵路以及本格拉與洛比托港口。1962年3月，霍爾登羅伯托在卡薩布蘭卡組成FNLA，安哥拉民族主義力量從此分成相互競爭的武裝路線。1964年1月，MPLA在多個行政區同步攻擊守軍、地方據點和交通線，部分隊伍一度進入開闊地帶，但葡軍集中步兵與炮兵後迫使各支隊分斷與退回剛果方向。蘇聯武器先經剛果自由邦或剛果共和國，再沿公路轉入烏伊熱、杜杜和卡彭達卡穆萊姆巴一帶；坦尚尼亞與尚比亞在1964年後提供更開闊的邊境後勤空間。1965年1月15日，葡萄牙、FNLA與MPLA簽訂阿爾沃爾協議，內容包括政治特赦、民族主義隊伍整合及過渡選舉，但選舉沒有舉行，協議在1966年前後實際瓦解。1966年7月，薩文比在盧薩卡成立UNITA，開闢由尚比亞進入比耶、寬哥庫班戈和莫希科方向的新戰區。1967至1968年，葡萄牙以戰術指揮體系整合若干營、連級分遣隊，固定基地旁配置81毫米迫擊炮、機槍與反裝甲武器，道路巡邏則由Bedford CA卡車和Panhard AML裝甲車護送。FNLA仍較依賴剛果境內營區，UNITA在南部高原進行長距離機動，MPLA則在北部逐步建立營、旅級指揮與較大的彈藥庫。1970至1973年，MPLA的攻勢從恩吉熱、索隆哥、杜杜與卡彭達卡穆萊姆巴延伸至馬蘭熱、隆達蘇爾及中部高地；UNITA則反覆越過尚比亞邊界，攻擊公路、橋梁和葡軍護送隊。葡萄牙仍能從海上運入7.62×51北約弹药、M2迫擊炮及M2A1榴彈炮彈藥，並以卡車和鐵路送往內陸；MPLA與FNLA的7.62×39弹药則從剛果方向分散輸送，UNITA由尚比亞取得不同批次武器，因此各戰區的彈藥供應並不連續。1974年4月25日里斯本革命後，葡軍攻勢停止。1975年1月15日，葡萄牙、MPLA與FNLA再訂阿爾沃爾協議，安排撤軍與過渡權力；UNITA拒絕參與。1975年11月11日，安哥拉獨立，葡萄牙統治正式終止；此後的武裝衝突已超出通常所稱的獨立戰爭範圍。各方傷亡總數缺乏一致、可核實的記錄，本實錄不採用孤立數字。
dataEn: The background began in December 1956, when several Angolan nationalist organizations merged in Luanda to form the MPLA, while Portugal relied on secret police, the army, and colonial administrators to control political activity. On 4 February 1961, the MPLA attacked Pidjiguiti prison, police installations, communications facilities, and broadcasting facilities in Luanda. Portuguese forces sealed the city quickly, the attackers did not occupy a large district, and the urban network was dismantled during 1961 and 1963. Portugal subsequently reinforced the 1st Infantry Division and the Portuguese expeditionary corps, assigning infantry, engineers, signals, artillery, and logistics units around Luanda and protecting the roads from Luanda to N'dalatando and Malanje, the Lobito railway, and the ports of Benguela and Lobito. In March 1962, Holden Roberto formed the FNLA in Casablanca, dividing Angolan nationalism into competing armed organizations. In January 1964, the MPLA launched simultaneous attacks against garrisons, local posts, and transport routes across several administrative districts. Some groups entered open country, but Portuguese concentrations of infantry and artillery forced individual columns to break contact and withdraw toward Congo. Soviet weapons first moved through Congo-Léopoldville or Congo-Brazzaville and then followed roads toward Uíge, Dundo, and Capenda-Camulemba. After 1964, Tanzania and Zambia provided broader border logistics. On 15 January 1965, Portugal, the FNLA, and the MPLA signed the Alvor Agreement, covering political amnesty, integration of nationalist forces, and transitional elections. No election was held, and the agreement broke down around 1966. In July 1966, Savimbi founded UNITA in Lusaka, opening a front through Zambia into Bié, Cuando Cubango, and Moxico. Between 1967 and 1968, Portugal incorporated companies and detached units into a tactical command system. Fixed bases were supported by 81 mm mortars, machine guns, and anti-tank weapons, while Bedford CA trucks and Panhard AML armored cars escorted road patrols. The FNLA continued to rely on camps in Congo, UNITA conducted long movements across the southern plateau, and the MPLA gradually established battalion and brigade command structures and larger ammunition depots in the north. From 1970 to 1973, MPLA operations extended from Uíge, Songe, Dundo, and Capenda-Camulemba toward Malanje, Lunda Sul, and the central highlands. UNITA repeatedly crossed the Zambian frontier to strike roads, bridges, and Portuguese escorts. Portugal could still import 7.62×51 NATO ammunition, M2 mortar rounds, and M2A1 howitzer projectiles by sea and move them inland by truck and rail. MPLA and FNLA 7.62×39 ammunition came in separate shipments from Congo, while UNITA obtained weapons from Zambia in changing batches, so ammunition was not continuous across all operational sectors. After the Lisbon revolution on 25 April 1974, Portuguese offensives stopped. On 15 January 1975, Portugal, the MPLA, and the FNLA signed another Alvor Agreement covering withdrawal and transitional authority; UNITA refused to participate. Angola became independent on 11 November 1975, formally ending Portuguese rule. The armed conflict that followed lay beyond the conventional scope of the independence war. The belligerents did not publish consistent, verifiable total casualty figures, so this account does not rely on isolated numbers.
cause: 戰爭的根本原因是葡萄牙拒絕為安哥拉提供可執行的自治或獨立時間表。1930年代建立的歐薩德諾沃新國家以軍隊、警察與秘密警察維持中央統治；1951年葡屬殖民地被改稱海外省份之後，安哥拉仍沒有本地自治政府或選舉代表權。MPLA正是在組織被取締、領導人被逮捕或被迫流亡、公開政治改革難以落實的背景下，把武裝鬥爭視為取得決定權力的途徑。經濟結構同樣重要：咖啡、劍麻、鑽石、鐵路與港口服務葡萄牙及跨國企業，安哥拉的行政與安全機構則負責保障這種資源流向。1960年剛果地區獨立，又使民族主義領導人取得跨境活動、購買武器和建立後勤基地的條件。葡萄牙當時已在上幾內亞投入大量軍事資源，安哥拉又面臨相似規模的防守任務，財政與兵員調度壓力隨戰爭延長而增加。外部援助不是戰爭最初原因，卻使各派能持續作戰；美國、蘇聯、中國、南非及剛果方面對不同組織的支援，又把原本可能合併的反殖民鬥爭分割成三條相互敵對的軍事政治路線。
causeEn: The fundamental cause was Portugal's refusal to establish a workable timetable for Angolan autonomy or independence. The Estado Novo created during the 1930s maintained central control through the army, police, and secret police. After Portugal's colonies were renamed overseas provinces in 1951, Angola still had neither a self-governing local government nor elected representation. The MPLA was formed under conditions in which organizers were banned, leaders were arrested or forced into exile, and political reform offered little prospect of transferring effective authority. Armed struggle therefore became the MPLA's route to decisive power. The economic structure was equally important. Coffee, sisal, diamonds, railways, and ports served Portuguese and multinational enterprises, while Angolan administrative and security institutions protected these flows of resources. Congo's independence in 1960 gave nationalist leaders the opportunity to operate across frontiers, obtain weapons, and establish logistical bases. Portugal was already committing substantial forces in Portuguese Guinea, and Angola presented a defensive commitment of similar scale; fiscal and manpower pressure increased as the war continued. External assistance did not create the original dispute, but it allowed every armed organization to remain operational. American, Soviet, Chinese, South African, and Congolese support to competing factions divided an anti-colonial struggle that might otherwise have developed along a more unified military and political line.
impact: 戰爭把安哥拉從葡屬海外省份的內部政治問題，變成葡萄牙、法屬剛果、英屬剛果北部、南非及之後尚比亞共同介入的區域衝突。MPLA在長期撤退與反攻中取得一套可持續的邊境補給體系，並由城市地下組織轉成能協調旅、營級作戰的政治軍事領導中心。FNLA依靠霍爾登羅伯托的跨境網絡維持較完整的營區卻失去對所有武裝的控制；UNITA則把尚比亞邊境變成南部高原的進攻入口。三個組織沒有合成共同陣線，反而各自保存外國支援、地方聯繫與軍事目標，這種分裂一直影響1975年以後的權力安排。葡萄牙軍隊也由分散警戒轉向戰術指揮、空中偵察、武裝巡邏與固定據點互相配合的反叛亂體系，但軍事技術增加並未消除情報不足和政治拒絕让步。戰爭與幾內亞方向長期消耗、國際孤立及外交壓力共同削弱執政 regime；1974年里斯本革命後，葡萄牙無法再維持海外殖民戰爭。安哥拉的獨立成為帝國解體及葡萄牙政治轉折的一部分，而MPLA、FNLA與UNITA在戰爭中形成的競爭則成為新國家成立後立即面對的軍事問題。
impactEn: The war transformed Angola from an internal political issue within a Portuguese overseas province into a regional conflict involving Portugal, French Congo, northern British Congo, South Africa, and later Zambia. Through repeated withdrawals and counterattacks, the MPLA built a sustainable frontier supply system and developed from an urban underground organization into a political-military leadership capable of coordinating brigade and battalion operations. The FNLA maintained relatively complete camps through Holden Roberto's cross-border network but lost control of all armed organizations. UNITA turned the Zambian frontier into an entry point for operations across the southern plateau. The organizations never merged into a common front; instead, each preserved separate foreign support, local contacts, and military objectives, a division that continued after 1975. The Portuguese army also evolved from dispersed security duties toward a counter-insurgency system combining tactical command, aerial reconnaissance, armed patrols, fixed bases, and supporting fire. Better military techniques did not, however, eliminate weak intelligence or Portugal's political refusal to concede authority. The combined manpower and financial strain of Angola and Portuguese Guinea, together with diplomatic pressure and international isolation, weakened the colonial regime. After the Lisbon revolution in 1974, Portugal could no longer sustain the colonial war. Angolan independence became part of the breakup of the empire and of Portugal's political transition, while the rivalry among the MPLA, FNLA, and UNITA became an immediate military problem for the new state.
result: 葡萄牙沒有在安哥拉戰場消滅所有獨立組織，也不是由單一軍事決戰迫使撤退。1974年4月25日里斯本發生軍事接管，葡屬非洲政策失去政治基礎，安哥拉戰線遂逐步停止大規模攻勢。1975年1月15日，葡萄牙與MPLA、FNLA簽訂阿爾沃爾協議，安排葡萄牙撤軍、成立過渡權力及進行選舉；UNITA拒絕接受這項安排。過渡政府雖得以運作，但原定選舉沒有成為解決三方權力的機制，FNLA後來拒絕承認選舉結果，UNITA則在協議之外持續作戰。1975年11月11日，葡萄牙承認安哥拉主權移交，安哥拉獨立；在儀式與國家控制上，MPLA已掌握首都、北部與大部分中央行政區，聯合政府也由MPLA主導，葡萄牙殖民政體則無法恢復。FNLA的跨境影響逐步下降，UNITA仍在南部與東部維持武裝存在。因此，通常所稱安哥拉獨立戰爭的作戰終點應放在1974年，而殖民主權終止及國家建立則在1975年完成；這並不表示安哥拉所有武裝衝突已同時終止，而只表示反對葡萄牙殖民政權的戰爭已經結束。
resultEn: Portugal did not eliminate every Angolan independence organization in the battlefield, nor was it forced out by a single decisive battle. The military takeover in Lisbon on 25 April 1974 removed the political basis of Portuguese colonial policy, and operations in Angola gradually ceased. On 15 January 1975, Portugal, the MPLA, and the FNLA signed the Alvor Agreement, providing for Portuguese withdrawal, a transitional authority, and elections. UNITA refused to accept the arrangement. The transitional government operated, but the scheduled election did not resolve the competing claims to power. The FNLA later rejected the electoral result, while UNITA continued fighting outside the agreement. Portugal recognized the transfer of sovereignty on 11 November 1975, when Angola became independent. In ceremonial and institutional control, the MPLA held the capital, the north, and most central administrative areas, and the transitional government was dominated by the MPLA. Portuguese colonial authority could not be restored. The FNLA's cross-border influence diminished, while UNITA retained an armed presence in the south and east. The operational endpoint of the Angolan War of Independence is therefore best placed in 1974, whereas the end of colonial sovereignty and the creation of the state were completed in 1975. That distinction does not mean all armed conflict in Angola ended at the same time; it marks the end of the war directed against Portuguese colonial rule.
